fact: The Ministry of Education's Eritrea: Essential Education Indicators 2023/24, the 26th annual report, is compiled from the annual school censuses carried out by the Zoba education offices through standard questionnaires (one administrative source: school returns); the 2022/23 edition of the same series is also cited as published.
title: Eritrea: Essential Education Indicators
publisher: Ministry of Education, Eritrea (reposted by Eritrean Center for Strategic Studies)
